responsibility: Declares the pass-3 symbol-building helpers used during executable quad generation. It provides scope setup for modules and procedures, import legality checks, subrange completion, constant symbol lookup, explicit-address variable handling, and optional-argument initializer recording, complementing `M2Quads` by handling the remaining symbol-table side effects needed while generating executable IR.
same_name_distinction: This definition module declares the pass-3 symbol-side helpers used during executable parsing; unlike P3SymBuild.mod, it exposes procedure signatures for scope setup, import checks, subrange completion, and initializer recording without implementing them.
